name: push
title: player:push
lead: A shove in blocks per tick, on top of what they are doing.

usedIn.quote: player:push(vec3(0, 1, 0))     -- a shove, in blocks per tick, on top of what they are doing
- `player:push` and a movement effect (`speed`, `jump_boost`, `levitation`, `slow_falling`, `dolphins_grace`) exempt the player while they last. `player:teleport` is always allowed.
